name: worker-addresses-by-their-symbols
description: A worker address is read by what its constructor resolves to: Node's Worker from worker_threads, imported under another name, through a namespace or bound by a require, reads a path against the package's directory, an output path naming the source it is emitted from, and names no file where the eval option makes the string code, while a browser's Worker, SharedWorker and service worker registration, read through globalThis too, read the address against the calling file. A thread a function nobody calls starts reaches its file from dead code only, and a constructor the target writes itself starts nothing.
